title: Global lift and cycle in a compatible horseshoe
statement: For a scheme X, a short exact module-sheaf sequence S, compatible injective resolutions IA, IB, IC with chain maps alpha, beta, zero composite, commuting augmentations and short exact rows, every global section q of S.X3 admits b in IB^0(X) and a cycle a in Gamma(IA)^1 such that beta^0(b)=aug_C(q) and alpha^1(iCycles(a))=d_B(b).

proof.text: Split each row by injectivity of IA^k and map its splitting by global sections. The resulting global complex sequence is short exact. Use the surjective degree-zero map to lift aug_C(q) to b.

The augmentation has zero differential, so the chain-map equation gives beta(d b)=0. Exactness in degree one gives x with alpha(x)=d b; the concrete cycle lemma gives d x=0 by monicity in degree two and d squared=0. Apply cyclesMk to x.

proof_origin.note: Second reader checked the reduction against the original horseshoe plan and Stacks Tags 0117, 013T and 015B.

mathlib_searches.query: Injective first object in a short exact sequence makes it split; an additive functor preserves split exactness
Connecting homomorphism computed on a cocycle from a lift through a short exact sequence of cochain complexes
The connecting homomorphism in a short exact sequence of cochain complexes sends the class of a cocycle to the class of the differential of a lift

lean.statement:
theorem boundary_horseshoe_global_lift (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))]
    [EnoughInjectives X.Modules]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [(RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).Additive]
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁)
    (IB : InjectiveResolution S.X₂) (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃)
    (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex)
    (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0)
    (_hιA : IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).map S.f ≫ IB.ι)
    (_hιB : IB.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).map S.g ≫ IC.ι)
    (hrows : ∀ k : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval X.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℕ) k)).ShortExact)
    (_hS : S.ShortExact) (q : S.X₃.val.obj (op ⊤)) :
    ∃ (b : (IB.cocomplex.X 0).val.obj (op ⊤))
      (a : (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).cycles 1),
      (β.f 0).val.app (op ⊤) b = (IC.ι.f 0).val.app (op ⊤) q ∧
      (α.f 1).val.app (op ⊤)
        ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).iCycles 1 a) =
          (IB.cocomplex.d 0 1).val.app (op ⊤) b
